protocol.runs: 92 = 4 clips x (a_naive on the recorded layout + b_level and b_tilt on the recorded layout and trials 0-9)
protocol.setup: PickPlace.run up to its first move (SetupOnly), incl. the 2 s hold
protocol.plan: one PathPlanner.plan_path(base='plan', base_goal=task._goal(G, R_G), return_fk=True) per run
protocol.reachable: FK error at G and at P < 1 cm and < 10 deg, AND path max position error < 2 cm
protocol.joint_limit_hit: a path frame in which any of the 14 arm joints is within 0.01 rad of its URDF limit
protocol.distances: mj_geomDistance from the 8 right-hand collision geoms (open hand) to cup_geom / cup_handle_* at the clip's frame i_G; negative = overlap
protocol.angles: deg; phi = heading of the palm normal, atan2(y, x)

palm_axes.method: PickPlace(mug_v1), spawn pose (no physics), oracle waypoints (z_clear 1.2 s, pre-grasp 1.8 s, grasp 2.0 s) in one plan_path(base='plan'); robot set to the last path frame (plant.reset with the clip's root pose + 29 joints), right and left hands at HERO's open pose, mug at its layout pose, mj_forward; palm frame = plant.palm_pose() (wrist_yaw_link + PALM_OFFSET); fingertips = body origins of right_hand_{thumb_2,index_1,middle_1}_link
